verdict.rationale: Reducto publishes a well-documented public API with an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, and CLI, and endpoints for parse, extract, split, route, and edit, confirmed live via runtime probes such as openapi.json serving concrete paths and llms.txt providing an agent-oriented index. This clearly satisfies driving the product programmatically as an AI-native user. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of API robustness and versioning stability beyond vendor docs.
